instruction: Set VLC so that every video is played at 1.5x speed by default, preserving my preferred playback rate.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because VLC does not have a persistent setting to remember playback speed preferences across all videos. While users can change playback speed during playback, VLC resets to normal speed (1.0x) when a new video is opened. There is no built-in preference setting to make a custom playback speed the default for all videos.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly identified as infeasible due to VLC's inherent limitation - it does not support persistent playback speed settings across videos
Evaluator appropriately uses 'infeasible' function to mark the task as impossible to complete
Clear explanation provided in metadata explaining why VLC cannot maintain playback speed preference across sessions
No verification logic is needed since the task cannot be completed - infeasible marker is the correct approach
